title: Calorie restriction uncouples mutation rate from lifespan
title_zh: 热量限制使突变率与寿命解耦
abstract: In this issue of Cell, Grońska-Pęski et al. examine how calorie restriction (CR) affects DNA mutation rates. While CR lowers the accumulation of mutations, this effect does not scale with the degree of lifespan extension. Their work raises important new questions about how CR impacts the causal mechanisms of aging.
abstract_zh: 本期Cell中，Grońska-Pęski等人研究了热量限制（CR）对DNA突变率的影响。虽然CR降低了突变的累积，但这种效应并不随寿命延长的程度成比例。他们的工作引发了关于CR如何影响衰老因果机制的重要新问题。
